sentences.text: Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 12857 of 2023

Petitioner :- Neha Mishra
Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 5 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Anwar Ali

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Singh,J.
1.Shri Sushant Mishra, Advocate, has filed his Vakalatnama in Court today on behalf of first informant.
The same is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the first informant and learned A.G.A. for the State.
3.

The instant writ petition seeks following relief:-
"Issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus commanding the respondent No.2 to produce the petitioner/victim before the court below for recording her second statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. in case crime No. 286 of 2023, under section 392, 376, 386, 323, 504, 506, 427, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Neha Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others on 17 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88604529/
1 Farrukhabad Kotwali, District-Farrukhabad."

entities.text: Police Station Neha Mishra vs State Of U.P. And 5 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
4. The instant writ petition seeks direction for getting the statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
5.
Learned counsel appearing for the respondent no.3 has stated that her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C., has been recorded much earlier in time.
6. Learned AGA has stated that the statement of petitioner has already been recorded on 11.07.2023 under Section 164 Cr.P.C.
He submits that the Police has filed charge-sheet in the matter.
7. Under the circumstances, nothing is required to be done by this Court.
The petitioner, if aggrieved, may approach the Magistrate for redressal of her grievances.
8. Subject to above, the writ petition is dismissed.
